description: List all treasury accounts (Holded API v2). Cursor-paginated: pass the previous response nextCursor as cursor. Response fields are snake_case; amounts are strings with decimal comma. WARNING: the `balance` field is a STATIC opening figure, not a live balance derived from transactions — do NOT rely on it for reconciliation or to compute the current cash position. Overlaps with list_bank_accounts/get_bank_account/create_bank_account (official treasury tools); consolidation planned for 2.1.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response nextCursor

fields.description: Project only these fields per item (e.g. ["id", "name", "balance"]). Reduces response size.

limit.description: Max items per page (server-paginated; use limit to control page size)

summary.description: Return only count and pagination metadata without items (default: false)

name: list_treasuries
